sectionPrivacy: What it protects, and what it doesn't
acquisitionIntro: Gender Diary runs in a browser. It opens straight away, with nothing to install and no account to make.
acquisitionAndroid: There is no Android app yet. When there is one, these are the four places to get it. Google Play is last for a reason. Each becomes a link once it works.

channels.name: Aurora
channels.note: The same build as Google Play, without your Google account attached to the download.

channels.name: F-Droid
channels.note: Builds the app from source itself, so you are not trusting a file that came from me.

channels.name: Obtainium
channels.note: Follows this project's releases on GitHub and keeps itself up to date.

channels.name: Google Play
channels.note: Works, and tells Google you have a trans app on your phone. Nothing in Gender Diary changes that.
